stage: document assetRefs are resolved, and the probe was reading a stale DLL
the_gap: AuthoredDocuments RESOLVED knowledgeRefs but only COUNTED assetRefs, so a document could point at an asset that does not exist while Studio said nothing. It now resolves them against the authored ids and reports a missing one, naming the consequence (the compiler fails the pack, the player sees no image). Verified synthetically: a document with assetRefs [urman.mini:asset/missing] is reported
the_harness_flaw_this_exposed: while debugging the synthetic case I found the CHECK WAS RIGHT and my probe was running against a STALE ASSEMBLY: /tmp/dsprobe/bin held Urman.Studio.Core.dll from 19:15 while the tree's copy was 20:44, because a HintPath reference does not reliably re-copy a rebuilt DLL. Any stage verified through that probe since the staleness began could have been judged against old code
the_fix: /tmp/runprobe.sh (also stored beside this receipt) rebuilds the three projects and COPIES their DLLs into the probe's output before running, so the probe cannot silently use an old build
why_this_matters: this is the same class of error as a vacuous check, one level up: a verification instrument that looks like it passes while measuring the wrong thing

verified.probe: PASS 790/790 after the fix, including the new missing-asset assertion
verified.not_run: no game launch: seeing the image is visual acceptance
